trained to the 72 min cap without learning to stand: the final mean training episode length is far below the 1000-step episode, and the exported policy fell in every evaluated episode in both MJX (mjx_eval_rsl_dr.json) and CPU MuJoCo (sim2sim_rsl_dr.json).
